name: Lolita Jutai ~Kawaii Imouto Futari wa Boku no Nikudorei~
original_name: ロリータ受胎～可愛い妹二人は僕の肉奴隷～
source:
Main character is an ordinary university student who loves his twin sister. One day he gets aphrodisiac and uncontrollable desire bursts out.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
